hints: We are searching for sub-array of length ≥ 2 and we need to split it to 2 non-empty arrays so that the xor of the first array is equal to the xor of the second array. This is equivalent to searching for sub-array with xor = 0.
Keep the prefix xor of arr in another array, check the xor of all sub-arrays in O(n^2), if the xor of sub-array of length x is 0 add x-1 to the answer.
